title: nlw-next-level-2009-open-weight
label: Magnus Destructo

won.source: The results post of Eye for an Eye, dated 8 November 2010, has Magnus Destructo defeat Impulse and be presented the belt as the inaugural champion; the event's own date is not stated.

how: Defeated Impulse in the main title match of Eye for an Eye in Hartford, the first holder of the title.
note: The Treason line-up of December 2010 puts the title on the line against Zesty Mordant; no result is held, and the owner's notice of 5 March 2011 says only that he owns the belt.
